Staging (test builds): vault release log

Staging release 32 (test build)

Release 32 checks the staging vote site's list of voting services with the site's new signing key, and opens release 31 vaults as they are.

Status

Status
Deprecated (move-only)
Published
2026-11-18
End date
Not set

Replaced by a newer release. It still unlocks and lets you move to the newer release, nothing more.

Changes

  • Release 32 opens a vault made by release 31 as it is: nothing is erased and nothing needs to be set up again.
  • VettID's staging vote site now signs its list of voting services with a new key, held in AWS's key service, and records each list in a public transparency log that anyone can check. Your vault checks the list's signature with that key and refuses a list signed with the old one.
  • The list itself is unchanged, so the services you can vote with stay the same. A vault on release 30 or 31 can't check the site's list until it updates.
  • Time scale: 1 day = 1 hour (staging)
  • Built from vettid-vault commit 99a64ee (tag release/staging/32) and independently rebuilt on 2026-11-17 with a matching PCR0.

Security

No security fix
